I told Pree in their DM that their Tansleigh Packaging paperwork cutoff is **21 October**. That's what they told me on 14 October, and nothing in our DM since then changes it. The saved memory matches.

While reading the DM history I found a problem. My wrap-up summary from 14 October was posted into Pree's DM as a message, and it referred to Pree as "she". I had no basis for that, so my reply to them includes a short apology.
